title: Design and implementation of large-scale genetic association studies of common diseases.

title: The cognitive neuroscience of consciousness.
description: This work seeks to understand how conscious visual experience arises from neural activity, and how it breaks down following brain damage. I have hypothesised on the basis of our previous work that conscious vision is correlated not only with activity in ventral visual cortex but also reflects top-down signals from dorsal frontal and parietal cortex.
